recognize_zh: 中倍下左側及中央是成片、細胞質較淡的大型細胞，與右側深染密集的小淋巴球殘存區形成明顯對比，顯示大細胞以黏著性片狀方式取代淋巴結結構，符合ALCL的浸潤型態。
features: Sheets of intermediate-to-large cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm occupying most of the field
Sharp contrast with a residual dark-staining cluster of small lymphocytes on the right
Cohesive growth pattern with thin fibrovascular strands
Large nuclei with vesicular chromatin, though hallmark features are not resolvable at this power
describe_en: Medium-power H&E section of lymph node shows cohesive sheets of intermediate-to-large cells with pale cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei, separated by delicate fibrovascular strands and replacing much of the normal architecture. A residual aggregate of small, dark lymphocytes is present at the right. The cohesive sheet-like growth of large pale cells is compatible with anaplastic large cell lymphoma, confirmed by strong uniform CD30 and T-cell/cytotoxic markers.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma forms cohesive nests that are keratin-positive and CD45/CD30-negative, whereas ALCL cells are CD30+ and keratin-negative (EMA may be positive in both).
DLBCL cells are CD20+/PAX5+ and lack uniform strong CD30 with hallmark horseshoe nuclei.
cHL has scattered HRS cells in a mixed inflammatory background rather than cohesive sheets, and is CD15+ with weak PAX5.
